sources.title: GitHub - PrachuryyaKaushik/CLASSER: CLASSER is a framework for cross ...
sources.snippet: CLASSER is a framework for cross-lingual annotation projection with script-similarity-based refinement to create high-quality fine-grained named entity recognition datasets. Utilizing CLASSER, fine-grained named entity recognition dataset is created in five languages: Assamese (as), Bodo (brx), Marathi (mr), Nepali (ne) and Sanskrit (as).

sources.title: HimalayaAI - Open Nepali AI Research
sources.snippet: A 0.5B parameter language model trained on Nepali language, available on Hugging Face. An open-source knowledge platform for use of AI in Education. A Nepali language tokenizer optimized for NLP tasks and large language model training. Large-scale text corpus in Parquet for GPT-2-style language model pretraining and tokenizer research.
